title: Romantic Getaway to Antigua: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Antigua. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Antigua sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
Antigua offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. If you are planning a romantic getaway to Antigua, you will find endless opportunities to create unforgettable memories. The sights, sounds, and flavors of Antigua come together in a way that feels both exciting and deeply comforting. This guide breaks down the essentials — from top attractions to local secrets — helping you craft an itinerary that matches your pace and your passions.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Antigua — bring a blanket and a bottle of wine
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments away from the crowds
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine in intimate, softly lit settings
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets hand in hand

![Romantic Antigua](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1662154477069-c8c0a5361a4c?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Cooking classes for two let you learn the secrets of Antigua's cuisine while bonding over delicious food. You will laugh, learn, and eat well — the perfect date.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Antigua. Splurge on a suite with a balcony for breakfast with a view.

## Planning the Perfect Evening

Surprise your partner with a picnic at one of Antigua's scenic spots. Local cheeses, fresh bread, and a sunset view make for an unforgettable evening.
